title: Converge ext4 Tier 1 lifecycle ownership
summary: Implement the bounded ext4 Tier 1 surface through OwnedFileIoRequest, MutationHandle, and MountSettlementOp, then prove one production RW durability path with G0-G7 evidence.

write_sets.notes: The coordinator owns the plan and JSON ledger. STATUS.md is an additive catch-up only; implementation workers must use isolated worktrees and the per-task paths in the Markdown plan.

steps.title: Reconcile HEAD and historical journal slices
steps.notes: Inspect the three historical slices and selectively map tests and invariants; never cherry-pick a whole worktree patch.

steps.title: Install the Tier 1 capability gate and fail closed
steps.notes: Reject unsupported shape before claims, PageSlot transitions, publication, or home-block writes; only the pinned 4 KiB Tier 1 profile is admitted.

steps.title: Add PageDataLease and OwnedFileIoRequest
steps.notes: The submit-failure value must retain the complete bundle; finish is the only terminalizer for success, stale completion, and error.

steps.title: Migrate PageBacked submission, resume, completion, and fsync
steps.notes: Remove parallel manual cleanup maps and route initial planning, queue failure, resume failure, device completion, stale generation, duplicate completion, and fsync through one owner table.

steps.title: Add MutationHandle and owned cross-yield tokens
steps.notes: Move lifecycle orchestration out of journal.rs; retain child request IDs, frozen metadata, allocator claims, and JournalExtentToken, never borrowed guards or PageDataLease bundles.

steps.title: Close abort drain, commit uncertainty, and checkpoint retry
steps.notes: Implement AbortRequested -> AbortDraining -> RolledBack, CommitUnknown -> RecoveryOnly, and CommittedNeedsSettlement retry without premature lease or ring release.

steps.title: Implement real FUA and flush durability
steps.notes: Consume device flags at the real bridge and emit an explicit post-commit flush whenever FUA is absent or unreliable; assert the device trace.

steps.title: Gate replay on recovery state and refresh caches
steps.notes: Require ext4 needs_recovery before replay, validate sequence/checksum, make barrier non-no-op, and refresh pager, bridge, mapping, inode, and directory caches after checkpoint/replay.

steps.title: Add revoke records and deferred-free ownership
steps.notes: Keep freed blocks unavailable until checkpoint and tail advancement prove replay safety; cover truncate, unlink, rename-overwrite, and orphan cleanup cuts.

steps.title: Migrate setattr as the first complete vertical slice
steps.notes: Make chmod, chown, timestamps, and size metadata use complete after-images and publish only after settled checkpoint.

steps.title: Migrate buffered data, bounded extents, and truncate
steps.notes: Use retained multi-page leases and one mutation generation; reject unsupported extent growth before any claim or PageSlot transition.

steps.title: Migrate namespace and classic orphan operations
steps.notes: Make create, mkdir, link, symlink, unlink, rmdir, rename, rename-overwrite, unlinked-open close, and crash-truncate one complete plan each; publish only after settlement.

steps.title: Add MountSettlementOp, errseq, and syscall routing
steps.notes: Route fsync, fdatasync, syncfs, sync, normal umount, and lazy detach through one operation; MNT_FORCE stays unsupported and MNT_DETACH retains payload ownership after topology withdrawal.

steps.title: Cut production to one RW path and add G0 lints
steps.notes: Remove production direct-home-write and legacy RW constructors; keep test/oracle paths explicit and require discovered journal, capability, recovery, and mutation ownership.

steps.title: Add one cargo xtask ext4 tier1 runner
steps.notes: RunWorkspace owns temporary directories, image copies, child processes, finalization, and failure receipts; users invoke only the single public Tier 1 command.

steps.title: Close G0-G7 with fresh product evidence
verification: jq -e '.schema == "tx.ext4.tier1_acceptance_receipt.v1" and .gates.G0 == "passed" and .gates.G7 == "passed" and .crash_cuts.completed == 1000 and .e2fsck.failures == 0 and .xfstests.skipped == 0 and .xfstests.not_run == 0' target/ext4/tier1/2026-07-30-tier1-candidate/acceptance-receipt.json
steps.notes: Promote only from the immutable receipt covering all 1000 deterministic crash cuts, fresh SCRATCH operation matrix, pinned xfstests, and post-run e2fsck; otherwise retain the plan active with the first blocker.

verification.notes: Required after every JSON ledger change.
Required after Markdown plan and status changes.
Required at each Rust implementation checkpoint.
Product evidence command implemented in Task 15 and executed in Task 16.

verification.command: e2fsck -fn on every immutable crash and replay image
verification.notes: Offline filesystem authority for G2, G4, G5, and G7.

risks: A direct pager call can create a second durability domain unless G0 rejects every production callsite.
A committed transaction with checkpoint failure requires retained authority and retry; treating it as rollback corrupts the live view.
FUA metadata without device capability enforcement can make fsync appear durable while the medium is not ordered.
Lazy detach can withdraw topology while DMA or settlement remains live; the MountPayload pin must outlive topology removal.
Host contract tests and reused serial logs can be mistaken for product evidence without fresh QEMU, immutable image, e2fsck, and xfstests receipts.
blockers: Current production namespace and pager paths still contain direct home writes and are not yet behind one MutationHandle.
Current block adapter ignores FUA flags and replay does not yet use the ext4 recovery-required gate on every production path.
The public cargo xtask ext4 tier1 command and its immutable acceptance receipt do not yet exist.
